subject: general
question: Name the female weightlifter from Manipur who has received India's highest sporting honour, Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna for 2018.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Saikhom Mirabai Chanu.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Saikhom Mirabai Chanu is an Indian weightlifter.
 
• She is the female weightlifter from Manipur who has received India's highest sporting honour, Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna for 2018.
 
• She is the winner of the silver medal at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics in the Women's 49 kg category.
 
• She belongs to Nongpok Kakching village in Manipur's Imphal East district.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hima Das, an Indian sprint runner from Dhing, Assam was nicknamed "Dhing Express".

 
 
• Currently, she holds the Indian National Record for 400 metres with a timing of 50.79 seconds which she won in the 2018 Asian Games in Jakarta, Indonesia.
 
 
 
• Mangte Chungneijang Mary Kom is an Indian Olympic boxer from the state of Manipur.
 
 
• She is the only woman to become World Amateur Boxing champion for a record six times.
 
• She has been nicknamed 'Magnificent Mary'.
 
 
 
• **Karna Malleswari** is a former Indian weightlifter born in Andhra Pradesh.
 
 
• She is the first Indian woman to fetch a medal at Olympics,
 
• She won a Bronze medal at Sydney Olympics, 2000.
 
• She was honoured with Rajiv Gandhi to help Ratna in 1995 and Padma Shri in 1999.
